description: The plot illustrates the massive activation of the baseline across different layers, comparing the maximum activation values of various components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1600, and tick labels at intervals of 200. The plot contains four lines: "attn_output" (blue dashed line), "attn_residual" (green dotted line), "ffn_output" (red dashed line), and "ffn_residual" (red solid line). The "attn_output" and "ffn_output" lines remain at 0 across the x-axis, while the "attn_residual" line starts at 0 and increases to around 1400 at layer 6, remaining steady until layer 17 before dropping to around 1200 at layer 20. The "ffn_residual" line also starts at 0, increases to around 1400 at layer 6, and remains steady until layer 17, then drops to around 1200 at layer 20.
